_comment: Routing-only descriptions, keyed by server__tool. Jev sees the hint instead of the server's own description; the LLM still gets the original schema. Use for tools whose descriptions are boilerplate, and to mark catch-all tools as a last resort.
notion__API-get-user: Get one Notion workspace user by id.
notion__API-get-users: List the users of the Notion workspace.
notion__API-get-self: Get the Notion integration's own bot user.
notion__API-post-search: Search Notion for pages and databases by title; use this to find a Notion page or doc by name before reading or editing it.
notion__API-get-block-children: Read the content blocks of a Notion page or block.
notion__API-patch-block-children: Append content (paragraphs, lists, etc.) to a Notion page.
notion__API-retrieve-a-block: Get one Notion content block by id.
notion__API-retrieve-a-page: Get a Notion page's properties (title, status, dates) by page id.
notion__API-patch-page: Update a Notion page's properties, e.g. status or title.
notion__API-retrieve-a-page-property: Get one property value of a Notion page.
notion__API-retrieve-a-comment: Read the comments on a Notion page or block.
notion__API-create-a-comment: Add a comment to a Notion page or discussion.
notion__API-query-data-source: Query the rows of a Notion database with filters and sorts.
notion__API-retrieve-a-data-source: Get a Notion database's schema (its properties).
notion__API-update-a-data-source: Change a Notion database's schema or title.
notion__API-list-data-source-templates: List the page templates of a Notion database.
notion__API-retrieve-a-database: Get a Notion database container and its data sources.
notion__API-move-page: Move a Notion page under a different parent.
notion__API-retrieve-page-markdown: Read a whole Notion page's content as Markdown.
notion__API-update-page-markdown: Replace or edit a Notion page's content using Markdown.
grafana__grafana_api_request: Last resort: raw HTTP call to the Grafana API, only when no dedicated Grafana tool (dashboards, annotations, alerting, incidents, Loki, Tempo...) covers the task.
kubernetes__kubectl_generic: Last resort: arbitrary kubectl command, only when no dedicated kubectl tool (get, describe, logs, scale, rollout, apply, delete, patch...) covers the task.
sentry__execute_sentry_tool: Last resort: run a long-tail Sentry operation found via search_sentry_tools, only when no direct Sentry tool (search_issues, search_events, update_issue, analyze_issue_with_seer...) fits.
sentry__search_sentry_tools: Last resort: discover long-tail Sentry operations, only when no direct Sentry tool (search_issues, search_events, update_issue, analyze_issue_with_seer...) fits.
